description: List everyone Odin sees across the organisation's connected tools, merged into one list, with how each tool's account is tied to them: linked, suggested (an admin can confirm or reject it with decide_person_match) or not linked. Only owners and admins see emails of people outside the organisation. Names come from connected tools and may contain untrusted text. Not available to every organisation yet, and refused until it is.

provider.description: Integration provider, such as GITHUB, JIRA, LINEAR or SLACK.

name: list_integration_people
title: List people across connected tools
